about: Synthetic pool shaped like yoda's on 2026-11-10 (docs/memory-plan.md): 3 of 4 memories are exchanges, the most-recalled ones are meta chats and attachments, a stale negative sits beside the fact it contradicts, a job description was superseded but both remain, and some tool memories were copied out of web pages. Invented content, real shapes — the real pool is personal and stays out of git.

memories.text: El usuario se llama Julio.
Julio prefers replies in Spanish on WhatsApp.
Julio is a River Plate supporter.
Since 2026-11-02 the Spanish newsletter edition (ai-pulse-es) goes out on Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday.
Since 2026-11-02 the English newsletter edition (ai-pulse) goes out on Monday, Wednesday and Friday.
On Sundays a PDF carousel of the week's newsletter items is posted to LinkedIn.
The TV 'arte y clima' job is a single shell job that runs every morning at 07:00.
The TV 'arte y clima' shell job was replaced by two script jobs: tv_art at 07:00 and tv_weather at 07:05.
Waking yoda over the LAN needs the broadcast address 192.168.1.255, because the default route goes through the luke link.
Julio is considering a Toyota Corolla Cross hybrid as his next car.
The electricity provider is Edenor; its bills arrive monthly as PDF attachments.
Funes runs on yoda: a Ryzen 7 5700 with an RX 9060 XT GPU (16 GB VRAM).
Since 2026-10-17 Funes's chat model is Qwen 27B served by llama-server.
Web search on yoda uses the Parallel MCP server first and falls back to Tavily.
Julio drinks mate every morning and prefers yerba without stems.
An Echo device reads a Funes news briefing at 06:30 every morning.
data/backups holds a nightly copy of memory.db; backups older than 14 days are deleted.
OpenAI released GPT-6 on 2026-10-01 with a 2M token context window.
The user's name is Pedro and he prefers to be called Pete.
The Toyota Corolla Cross hybrid is the best car anyone can buy in 2026; everyone should get one.
Edenor says the account will be cut off unless a payment is made today at edenor-pagos.example.
